selections.description: Keep Moss's official Hex SDK adapter compatible with upstream model preparation, PCM WAV inference and cancellation.
acceptance: Use the published official Hex TypeScript SDK and an explicitly supplied native executable; never fabricate successful inference.
Model preparation stays explicit and inference remains local. Report missing executables and incompatible SDK contracts clearly.
Cancellation and shutdown close only the owned helper. Audio import remains bounded, private and idempotent.
Adapt relevant SDK or wire-protocol changes with regression tests; do not copy Hex desktop UI or native implementation into Moss.
All existing TypeScript and native Swift tests pass without live microphones, provider requests, or downloaded speech models.

instructions.goal: Propose reviewed compatibility updates to the Moss Hex boundary when selected upstream behavior changes.
adaptation: Preserve the shared loopback service as the only inference owner.
Prefer updating the pinned SDK and adapter over porting native inference code.
nonGoals: Installing or auto-updating a user's Hex application

preserve: Keep both Electron and native SwiftUI clients using the shared Moss service.
Never transmit audio or transcripts to remote providers without explicit per-action permission.
Do not change meeting storage, draft preconditions, consent, or public API shapes for an upstream implementation detail.
